csv_project_name: As Needed Engineering for Moorhead Municipal Airport
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Moorhead, MN is requesting Statements of Qualifications from interested and qualified Aviation Consultants for Professional On-Call Airport Engineering and Architectural Services at Moorhead Municipal Airport Florence Klingensmith Field ( Airport ). Professional, technical and advisory services are needed for projects identified in the Airport s Capital Improvement Program (CIP) and other projects as needed and directed. rojects may include airport planning and environmental services, airside/landside design and construction administration, airport building design, and AIP program management. Projects will be accomplished during the course of multiple years and grants, some services may not be required and City reserves the right to initiate projects and procurement actions. The projects anticipated to occur in the next five years include: 1) Install or Relocate Weather Reporting Equipment 2) Construct, Move and/or Expand Fuel Farm 3) Install, Reconstruct and/or Maintain Runway Visual Guidance System (REIL, PAPI, ALS) 4) Conduct/Update Miscellaneous Studies (e.g. ALP, Property Inventory, Clear Zone, Acquisition Plans, Building Studies, etc.) 5) Equipment Acquisition (e.g. snow removal equipment) 6) Pavement Inspection, Design, Engineering, Bidding, Construction Administration including Close out of Construction for New Pavement, Pavement Rehabilitation (i.e. mill and overlay, crack remediation & repair, etc.) and/or Reconstruction of projects including, but not limited to: o Rehabilitate/Reconstruct, Expand or Construct Runway, Taxiway, Hangar Area Pavement and/or Aprons o Rehabilitate/Reconstruct, Expand or Construct service roads, driveways, parking areas o Rehabilitate/Reconstruct, Expand or Construct taxilanes 7) Electrical building and/or building components repairs or updates 8) Beacon repairs 9) Rehabilitate / Reconstruct Airfield drainage 10) SWPPP Preparation and Updates 11) Grant administration including closeout reports 12) Airport Facilities and Hangar Renovation 13) Instrument Approach Procedure Development 14) Land and Property Acquisition 15) General Aviation Ramp Rehabilitation/Reconstruction 16) Building Area Site Preparation 17) General Aviation Area Redevelopment/New Development 18) Hangar Design and Construction 19) Surveying 20) Disadvantaged Business Enterprise Plans and updates
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Rehabilitation & Refurbishment, Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Pollution Studies, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Stormwater, Transportation Planning

project_scope: Multi-year on-call professional services for airport capital improvement and related projects at a municipal airport. Anticipated tasks over the next five years include weather reporting equipment installation or relocation; fuel farm construction, relocation or expansion; runway visual guidance systems; miscellaneous studies; equipment acquisition; pavement inspection, design, bidding and construction administration for new pavement, rehabilitation and reconstruction of runways, taxiways, hangar area pavement, aprons, service roads, driveways, parking areas and taxilanes; electrical building repairs; beacon repairs; airfield drainage rehabilitation; SWPPP updates; grant administration; airport facilities and hangar renovation; instrument approach procedure development; land acquisition; general aviation ramp rehabilitation or reconstruction; site preparation; redevelopment or new development in general aviation areas; hangar design and construction; surveying; and DBE plan updates. No specific dimensions, spans, or building areas are stated.
services: Professional on-call airport engineering and architectural services, including airport planning, environmental services, airside and landside design, construction administration, airport building design, AIP program management, civil engineering, architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, land use planning, master planning, pollution studies, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, stormwater, and transportation planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style on-call airport consulting contract with very broad scope and no defined structural project.
- Main focus is airport planning, pavement, drainage, studies, grant administration, and general engineering rather than distinctive structural design.
- Includes hangar design and airport building work, but no specific long-span, architecturally demanding, or innovative structure is identified.
- Contains many service areas outside sbp core focus, such as environmental, surveying, DBE plans, and program management.
- Airport buildings and hangars could be marginally relevant, but the notice is too unspecific for high priority.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction budget is stated in the source. The notice describes an as-needed five-year airport CIP support contract covering many possible small to medium airport projects, including pavements, drainage, fuel farm, hangars, and facilities, but provides no total program value from which a reliable USD construction cost can be derived.
fee_explanation: No design fee or contract value is stated in the source. This is an on-call RFQ for multiple future airport projects over a 60-month period, so a realistic sbp fee cannot be determined from the available information.
